text:
olivia: Quick sync — we need a single telemetry fanout for token cost breakdowns. Goal: show `cost_per_1k` + explicit savings buckets (cache, batching, routing fallbacks). Who owns runtime payload changes?

raj: I can own the runtime schema change, but want minimal per-request payload to avoid perf regressions.

olivia: Thanks. Thinking shape: attach a small `telemetry` object on responses with lightweight fields. Example: 
```json
{
  \"tokens_in\": 120,
  \"tokens_out\": 980,
  \"batch_size\": 8,
  \"cache_hit\": true,
  \"routing_policy\": \"cost-first\",
  \"model_variant\": \"lama-13b-q4\"
}
```
This should let us compute `cost_per_1k` and attribute delta to cache/batch/routing.

micah: We should avoid emitting per-request `gpu_ms` and high-cardinality floats for every call. Propose: 1) per-route 1m aggregates (sum tokens, count, cache_hits, avg_batch) 2) sample 1/1000 full traces for p50/p95 runtime metrics. Cheaper and still actionable.

kevin: From Console side: dashboard needs a waterfall visualization: gross cost -> cache savings -> batching savings -> routing fallback cost -> net cost_per_1k. Also need a per-model+route table and the ability to filter by `capacity_tier` and tenant quota class.

sophie: Rollouts UX note: when we flip quantization/variant we must show both cost_per_1k delta and quality regression metrics (eval set). UX should let PMs toggle to \"compare last N rollouts\" and surface sample outputs.

raj: Agree on aggregate + sampling. Proposed metric names (proto): `redwood.tokens.in`, `redwood.tokens.out`, `redwood.cache.hit_rate` (ratio), `redwood.batch.avg_size`, `redwood.runtime.gpu_ms.samples` (histogram samples). Keep per-request payload minimal and derive cost server-side.

micah: Also include a `routing_policy` tag (latency|cost|regional) and `capacity_tier` label in aggregates so we can slice by policy impact.

olivia: Action items: @raj make schema PR (runtime) by EOD Wed; @micah add 1m aggregate emission + sampling flag; @kevin start dashboard skeleton (waterfall + table) with placeholders; @sophie list rollout UX fields and wireframes. I'll create a short deck and link infra jira.

infra-bot: deploy: telemetry-collector v2 rolled out to staging at 2026-03-19T14:12Z

kevin: :thumbsup: Quick question — do we keep existing `token_unit` metric or replace with `cost_per_1k`?

raj: Keep both for now. `cost_per_1k` is derived: `cost_per_token * 1000` plus route-specific overrides. Keep `token_unit` for backward compatibility with billing.

sophie: Also want alerting: if `cache_hit_rate` drops by >10% from baseline -> trigger evaluation job and send to #incidents.

olivia: Perfect. I'll open a tracking Jira: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-789> and post links to PRs here. Reconvene after PRs land.
